Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 lSt_date varchar2(15);
 lEnd_date varchar2(15);
 v_gmt_time date;
 v_lSt_Date date;
 v_lEnd_Date date;
begin
 
 if :rbg_cal = 'DAILY' then
 
 lSt_Date := to_char(:hi_date_st,'mm-dd-rr') || ' ' || to_char(:st_time,'hh24:mi');
 lEnd_Date := to_char(:hi_date_st,'mm-dd-rr') || ' ' || to_char(:calendar_highlights.hi_date_endtime,'hh24:mi');
 
 v_lSt_Date := to_date(lSt_Date,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');
 v_lEnd_Date :=to_date(lEnd_Date,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');
 
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,v_lSt_Date,v_gmt_time);
 :calendar_highlights.hi_date := v_gmt_time;
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,v_lEnd_Date,v_gmt_time);
 :calendar_highlights.hi_date_endtime := v_gmt_time;
 else
 :calendar_highlights.hi_date := to_date(lSt_Date,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');
 :calendar_highlights.hi_date_endtime := to_date(lEnd_Date,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');
 end if;
 
 --:calendar_highlights.hi_date := to_date(lSt_Date,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');
 --:calendar_highlights.hi_date_endtime := to_date(lEnd_Date,'mm-dd-rr hh24:mi');
 :calendar_highlights.hi_status := :lv_status;
 :calendar_highlights.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 end if;
-- :calendar_highlights.hi_month := :ctrl_block.hi_month;
 :calendar_highlights.start_date := :ctrl_block.start_date;
 :calendar_highlights.end_date := :ctrl_block.end_date;
 :calendar_highlights.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :calendar_highlights.insert_user := :banner.user_id;
 :calendar_highlights.insert_date := sysdate;
 :calendar_highlights.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 
 
end;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS

 local_sysdate DATE; 

BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.04';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '05'; -- LT 4.1.0 IM :2152
 --:global.program_version := '06'; -- IM # 4694 - Added chapter_id to calendar_highlights table and query
 --:global.program_version := '07'; -- IM 4694
 --:global.program_version := '08'; -- IM# 5320
 --:global.program_version := '09'; -- IM# 5320 (issue related to "Daily" and "Date Range" radio button options)

PROCEDURE check_month_year 
 ( pmonth IN varchar2, 
 pyear IN varchar2,
 result OUT varchar2)
IS

BEGIN
 result := 'MORE';
 if to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMM') >
 to_char(to_date(pmonth||pyear, 'MMYYYY'), 'YYYYMM')
 then
 result := 'LESS';
 end if;
END;

PROCEDURE check_del_rec (p_yesno varchar2) IS
 al_id alert;
 al_text varchar2(100);
 al_button number;
begin
 if p_yesno = 'YES' then
 al_id := Find_Alert('choice_alert'); 
 IF Id_Null(al_id) THEN 
 Message('Choice_alert alert does not exist'); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 ELSE
 set_alert_property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Do you want to delete this record?');
 al_button := Show_Alert(al_id); 
 IF al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 delete_record;
 :system.message_level := 10;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 al_id := Find_Alert('inform_alert'); 
 IF Id_Null(al_id) THEN 
 Message('inform_alert alert does not exist'); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 ELSE
 set_alert_property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Message created in past date, cannot delete.');
 al_button := Show_Alert(al_id); 
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 ---------- Following added by Mukesh 05/28 --------------

 ----------------------------------------------------------
